name: Bambu Indah
description: Antique Javanese houses beside a sacred river.

name: Mana Earthly Paradise
description: Next-generation eco-villas run by an NGO, built from earth bags and recycled wood, powered by solar, with a probiotic restaurant and permaculture garden.

name: Sarinbuana Eco Lodge
description: Pioneering eco lodge on the rainforested slopes of Mount Batukaru, with bamboo bungalows, a permaculture garden, chemical-free pool, and guided jungle treks.

name: Bali Eco Stay
description: Overwater bungalows above rice paddies in central Bali, powered by a private waterfall, with spring water, organic on-site food, and total immersion in nature.

name: Fivelements Retreat Bali
description: Award-winning eco-wellness sanctuary on the Ayung River, with bamboo villas, plant-based cuisine, traditional Balinese healing rituals, and over 90 global sustainability awards.

name: Chapung Sebali
description: Eco-luxury jungle resort above the Wos River Valley, blending traditional Indonesian and Scandinavian design with organic dining and uncompromising sustainability.

name: Arya Arkananta Resort & Spa
description: Tranquil eco resort nestled in rice fields in Sayan, Ubud, with traditional wooden villas, therapeutic spa, vegetarian dining, and deep immersion in Balinese village life.

name: Komaneka at Bisma
description: Travelife Gold certified boutique resort owned by a Balinese family, set on a slope above the Campuhan river valley with rice field views, Indonesian fine dining, and its own organic gardens.

name: Bagus Jati Health & Wellbeing Retreat
description: Independent hilltop wellness retreat at 750m in Tegallalang, with yoga, Ayurveda, detox programs, organic cuisine, and guided nature treks rooted in Tri Hita Karana philosophy.

name: Swasti Eco Cottages
description: Charming family-run eco cottages in the quiet woodcarvers' village of Nyuh Kuning, with an organic garden and restaurant, eco-spa using 100% natural products, and a genuine community feel.
